title.narrative: Anglicans in Development - Australian NGO Cooperation Program (ANCP)

description.narrative: Established in 1974, the Australian NGO Cooperation Program (ANCP) is the Australian Government's longest running and largest program with Australian Non-Government Organisations (NGOs). Through the ANCP, the Australian Government partners with accredited Australian NGOs to implement projects consistent with the goals of Australia’s development program. In any given year, ANCP accredited NGOs deliver approximately 400 projects in around 50 countries, within a range of sectors including education, health, food security, and civil society strengthening.
